registry.source_note: Entries are project-level starting dispositions derived from the supplied protocol. Historical derivations remain provisional until independently lexicographically sourced.

morphological_structure.value: Morphological segmentation has not been established.

historical_derivation.value: Historical derivation and earliest relevant attestation require an independent lexicographic source.

semantic_range.value: Historical and synchronic sense range remains unresolved.

local_sense.value: Local syntax and sense require direct inspection of the cited source spans; topic detection is insufficient.

philosophical_function.value: The local philosophical function remains unresolved.

translations.value: Standard, alternative and working translations remain unresolved.

translation_residual.value: Translation loss has not yet been discriminated in the source context.

etymological_risk.value: Root fallacy, semantic anachronism, false cognate, translation collapse, selective etymology, authorial-etymology smuggling and etymology→ontology promotion remain active risks.

lost_distinction.value: No discriminating lost distinction has yet been established.

semantic_drift.value: No source-resolved semantic drift has yet been established.

new_question.value: No etymologically generated philosophical question has yet been established.

cards.revision_trigger: Reopen the card when a dated primary occurrence, authoritative historical dictionary entry, translation witness or phenomenological contrast changes form, sense, function or the proposed bridge.

coverage.interpretation: Coverage is complete because every central concept received ETY-MIN and every escalated concept received all ETY-FULL contours. This does not mean that unresolved historical, local or phenomenological fields have been answered.
